goal_native: 快速洗一次衣服（お急ぎ 快洗模式）
goal_en: Run a quick wash (お急ぎ mode)
intro_native: 这是一台日本的全自动洗衣机，面板上都是日文。别担心，我们一起用快洗模式洗一次衣服，一共四步。
intro_en: This is a Japanese washing machine, so the panel is all in Japanese. Don't worry — we'll run a quick wash together in four steps.

buttons.function_native: 打开或关闭洗衣机。按一下开机，再按一下关机。
buttons.function_en: Turns the washer on or off.

buttons.function_native: 转动选择洗衣程序：标准、快洗、毛毯、洗槽清洁、轻柔洗、漂洗、单脱水。
buttons.function_en: Turn it to choose a program: normal, quick, blanket, drum clean, delicates, rinse, spin only.

buttons.function_native: 选择洗涤水温，按一次换一档。
buttons.function_en: Chooses the water temperature; each press moves one level.

buttons.function_native: 调整脱水的强度和时间，按一次换一档。
buttons.function_en: Sets spin strength and time; each press moves one level.

buttons.function_native: 设置几个小时后自动开始洗衣。
buttons.function_en: Starts the wash automatically after a few hours.

buttons.function_native: 锁住面板，防止小孩误操作。长按三秒开启或解除。
buttons.function_en: Locks the panel. Hold for three seconds to turn on or off.

buttons.panel_text: スタート / 一時停止
buttons.function_native: 开始洗衣；洗的过程中再按一下就是暂停。
buttons.function_en: Starts the wash; press again during a wash to pause.

steps.narration_native: 先开机。看面板最左边，有一个圆形按钮，上面有红色的开机图标，下面写着日文「電源」。按一下它，屏幕会亮起来。
steps.narration_en: First, turn it on. On the far left there's a round button with a red power symbol, labelled 電源. Press it once and the display lights up.

steps.action_en: Turn the dial to お急ぎ
steps.narration_native: 接下来选洗衣程序。中间那个大圆旋钮，把蓝色的指示线转到右上方写着「お急ぎ」的位置，这就是快洗模式。
steps.narration_en: Next, choose the program. Turn the big round dial in the middle so the blue line points to お急ぎ at the upper right — that's quick wash.

steps.action_en: Press 脱水 to set the spin
steps.narration_native: 如果衣服比较厚，可以按右上角写着「脱水」的白色按钮，多按几次可以加强脱水。衣服薄的话这一步可以跳过。
steps.narration_en: If your clothes are heavy, press the white 脱水 button at the top right a few times for a stronger spin. For light clothes you can skip this.

steps.narration_native: 最后，按右下角那个最大的蓝色按钮，上面写着「スタート」，就是启动。听到「哔」一声，洗衣机就开始工作了。
steps.narration_en: Finally, press the big blue button at the bottom right labelled スタート. You'll hear a beep and the wash begins.

tips.native: 衣服不多时用快洗最省时间；厚衣服记得加强脱水。
tips.en: Quick wash saves time for small loads; use a stronger spin for heavy clothes.

warnings.native: 洗衣机运转时不要打开盖子，也不要把手伸进去。
warnings.en: Don't open the lid or reach inside while the drum is moving.

closing_native: 好啦，洗衣机已经开始工作了，大约 38 分钟后就洗好。有问题随时问我！
closing_en: That's it — the machine is running and will finish in about 38 minutes. Ask me anything!
